items.t: ING Is Getting Cold Feet on the AI Boom
items.sum: ING is shopping $500 million in loans tied to US data center projects, including one connected to OpenAI-backed Stargate. The sale isn’t a distress signal, but it raises questions about who will finance AI’s increasingly expensive buildout.
